messages.content: Four travellers must cross a bridge at night with one torch. At most two cross at a time and a pair moves at the slower person's pace. They take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes. What is the fastest total crossing time, and what is the schedule?

This is the classic bridge crossing puzzle with crossing times 1, 2, 5, 10 minutes. The fastest solution: send 1&2 across (2 min), send 1 back (1 min), send 5&10 across (10 min), send 2 back (2 min), then 1&2 cross again (2 min) — totaling …[9823 chars]

**The fastest total time is 17 minutes.** **Schedule** (torch travels with each crossing): | Step | Who moves | Direction | Time | Elapsed | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | 1 and 2 | cross | 2 | 2 | | 2 | 1 | returns with torch | 1 | 3 | | 3 | …[1302 chars]
